entries.text: Sign Doc · Session UX in all 33 languages; the countersigner reads a document and their next action, never the machine.
The signer never meets the machine — a person signing on their phone must never be shown a database, migration, RPC, quota or vendor.
One sentence for every infrastructure failure; the operator's door is ?diag=1; enforced mechanically in all 33 languages by tests/sign-lexicon-voice.test.mjs in test:ci.
A completed signature is never discarded — the finished file survives any backend failure (FIX THE CLASS, docs/AAR_2026-09-09_THREE_DEAD_ENDS.md).
